text: On it — checking Alvarez's calendar and the senate meeting before I write to him.

One thing before I write it on the calendar: a senate cancellation only counts with the office, so I've asked the department to confirm Wednesday 10:00 in writing — I've told Professor Alvarez the same. As soon as they confirm, I'll book it and log it. Nothing goes on my calendar until then.

Settled — but not the way the hallway note said. The department office confirmed in writing that Wednesday's faculty senate (10:00-11:00) was **not** cancelled, so 10:00 was out; Professor Alvarez said the same. We agreed on **Wednesday 13:00-13:30** instead, and he has booked and logged it in his calendar. My calendar now has the entry for Wed 18 Nov 13:00-13:30; the plan is done.
